capture_eligibility.downgraded_excluded: a TUE/FRI request downgraded to horizon=SMOKE never qualifies
capture_eligibility.exactly_one_per_horizon: Require exactly one designated COMPLETE capture per production horizon per season/week. If more than one COMPLETE capture exists for a horizon and nothing in the manifest designates one unambiguously, FAIL CLOSED.
capture_eligibility.no_outcome_peeking: Never choose a capture after seeing outcomes.
capture_eligibility.qualifying_capture: manifest.json status == 'COMPLETE' AND manifest.json horizon == the directory horizon

report: RMSE improvement = market RMSE - candidate RMSE

formula.FRI_QB_PASS_YARDS: projected passing_yards of PRIMARY_PROJECTED_QB in the official FRI capture
formula.TUE_QB_PASS_YARDS: projected passing_yards of PRIMARY_PROJECTED_QB in the official TUE capture
formula.no_transform: The raw shadow row stores QB_PROJECTION_SHOCK_FRI un-standardized and un-transformed.
formula.sign_convention: Positive means the home team's expected QB passing production improved relative to the away team's expectation from Tuesday to Friday.

friday_kickoff_eligibility.cutoff_source: the official Friday capture's manifest.json persisted `nominal_cutoff_utc`; never recomputed or guessed.
friday_kickoff_eligibility.excluded_at_or_before_cutoff: scheduled_kickoff_utc <= official FRI nominal_cutoff_utc => omitted before QB projection resolution.
friday_kickoff_eligibility.kickoff_missing_or_unparseable: classified INVALID_KICKOFF and omitted with an explicit reason (fail closed; no row).
friday_kickoff_eligibility.kickoff_source: BDL games*.json field `date`, parsed timezone-aware as UTC.
friday_kickoff_eligibility.rule: A Friday shadow row is eligible only when scheduled_kickoff_utc > official FRI nominal_cutoff_utc (STRICTLY greater).

market_residual_definition.market_state: official FRI BDL/market state captured at the production cutoff, under the existing production market rules

maturity_gates.bootstrap_inference: later task ONLY if ADVANCE is reached
maturity_gates.if_advance_not_reached: do not add the signal to production

frozen.missing_rule: If either team's PRIMARY_PROJECTED_QB cannot be resolved (no QB record with numeric passing_attempts and passing_yards, or a tie for greatest passing_attempts) in EITHER the official TUE or the official FRI capture, the game is OMITTED from the v2026.7.1 shadow ledger. Fail closed; never impute.

online_learning_rule.estimator: sklearn Pipeline: StandardScaler THEN Ridge(alpha=100, fit_intercept=True, solver='svd')
online_learning_rule.scaler_fit: StandardScaler fit on prior training rows only
online_learning_rule.training_rows: ONLY previously settled eligible 2026 shadow rows (result available when that Friday forecast was created)

primary_qb_rule.audit: Persist the selected BDL player_id for audit only.
primary_qb_rule.selection: PRIMARY_PROJECTED_QB = the team QB with the greatest projected stats.passing_attempts

frozen.purpose: Prospective feature discovery: does the Tuesday->Friday change in the primary QB's projected passing yards carry incremental information beyond the FRIDAY sportsbook spread? Spread/margin only.

scope.totals: TOTAL is NOT evaluated in v2026.7.1

supersedes.reason: Pre-first-observation Friday kickoff eligibility hardening. No real TUE/FRI captures, no shadow rows, and no joined outcome existed at the time of this change.

frozen.tie_rule: A tie for the greatest passing_attempts => team state unavailable (no imputation).

warmup.during_warmup: store signal; store later outcome/market residual; report descriptive statistics only

note: Frozen before any 2026 outcome is joined to the signal. v2026.7.1 hardens Friday kickoff eligibility (scheduled_kickoff_utc > official FRI nominal_cutoff_utc) prior to the first real observation. No signal definition may change after the first scored outcome is observed.
